title: Manage Stock Pools
readerIntent: Group balances for business purposes without creating another authority.
priorKnowledge: Understand warehouses, balances, scopes, and sourcing.
summary: StockPool is an Inventory-owned grouping used for availability and sourcing policies, not a separate module or duplicated balance.

sections.heading: Configure
items: Stable code, tenant/enterprise, purpose, active state, eligible balances/warehouses, product restrictions, service scopes, priority, safety policy, and fallback.
Use pools for sellable, reserved-purpose, campaign, channel, zone, segment, damaged/quarantine, or project-defined purposes.
Prevent cycles, duplicate balance ownership assumptions, cross-tenant references, and ambiguous priorities.
